|notes=Gold targets the opposing character with the highest printed power, prevents a drain there and is immune to Alter. The intermediate publisher face retains the drain ban, specifies the target is at a site and removes Alter immunity. The dated June replacement requires a friendly non-droid, also prohibits movement, can target a Jedi at a site and caps your loss to those drains at 1 Force. The gallery face prints collector 26 while both sheets print 27. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 27]. [[:File:VS11O-27-Luke_Luuuuke.png|June replacement slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=3 Players Committee final sheet, p. 3, slip 27].
